title: SWF: SoundStreamHead and SoundStreamBlock tags
description: Test that a layer with stream-mode sound (syncMode='stream') produces SoundStreamHead (tag 18) and SoundStreamBlock (tag 19) tags. Verify: (1) tag 18 appears before first frame with sound data, (2) SoundStreamHead has correct codec byte, (3) SoundStreamBlock body has non-zero length. If streaming sound is not yet implemented, document with .todo tests.
